name: since-cutoff
description: Find which of your exact Python dependency versions your coding model writes wrong, and fix it with short, type-checked AGENTS.md notes.

interface.shortDescription: Which of your pinned Python dependencies changed their API after the model's training cutoff.
interface.longDescription: Reads the project's lockfile and statically diffs each dependency's public API between the release at the model's training cutoff and the version you pin. The MCP tools and `since-cutoff scan` stop there: no model calls, no API key. `since-cutoff run` also tests the model on short tasks that need the changed APIs, scores its code with basedpyright against both versions, and writes one-line AGENTS.md notes that are kept only if their example type-checks.
defaultPrompt: Which of this project's dependencies changed their API since your training cutoff?
Before you write the httpx code, check what changed in httpx since your cutoff.
